## Change

Describe the problem, the user-facing change, and the affected workflow.

## Verification

List the commands actually run and their results. Separate unit/mocked tests from live integrations; state which relevant checks were not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes an appropriate test or explanation.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes current behavior from planned capabilities.
- [ ] Historical reference results were not replaced by new experiment outputs.
- [ ] Added code and assets have clear sources and compatible licenses.
- [ ] No credentials, private household data, or real cloud-device identifiers are included.
- [ ] No routine test executes network attacks or real-device commands.
